name: SIPASI PDAM
experienceLabel: As a Full-Stack Web Developer Intern at PDAM Tirta Makmur Surakarta, I collaborated directly with the Corporate Secretariat and IT Division to transform correspondence and official document disposition workflows, which were previously handled through manual, paper-based processes.
contributions: Conducted in-depth requirements interviews with the Corporate Secretariat and IT leadership to model hierarchical document disposition workflows using a digital state machine.
Designed a normalized PostgreSQL relational database schema using Prisma ORM, implementing strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
Built a high-performance, responsive dashboard interface using Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, and Tailwind CSS.
Developed a dynamic QR code digital stamping generator that automatically embeds digital stamps into official PDF documents.
Implemented a permanent forensic audit logging system to track document creation, disposition, downloads, and access history.
Led User Acceptance Testing (UAT) sessions with department heads and continuously refined the system through iterative operational improvements.
impactSummary: Reduced document disposition turnaround time from 48–72 hours to an average of under 5 minutes through digital workflow automation.
impacts: Reduced document disposition turnaround time from 48–72 hours to an average of under 5 minutes through digital workflow automation.
Eliminated 100% of physical photocopy paper consumption for disposition memos across all 15 operational divisions of PDAM Tirta Makmur Surakarta.
Prevented potential loss of critical documents through transparent, real-time tracking of document status and assigned responsibilities.
Improved internal audit compliance through cryptographically secured digital audit trails for every document export.
highlights: Dynamic Status Tracking: Displays real-time document statuses, including New, Awaiting Executive Disposition, Disposition Completed, and Archived.
Smart Incoming/Outgoing Mail Registration: Intelligent registration forms with automated numbering based on archival classification codes.
Instant Filtering: Enables quick document filtering by date, urgency level (Normal, Urgent, Confidential), and originating institution.
Automated Dynamic QR Code Integration: Automatically embeds dynamic QR codes in the corner of disposition sheets without altering the original document layout.
